auth.label: Public API Key
auth.description: Referral Rock public API key used as the HTTP Basic username.

extraFields.label: Private API Key
extraFields.description: Referral Rock private API key used as the HTTP Basic password.

actions.name: get_member_stats
actions.description: Get sharing, referral, and reward statistics for one Referral Rock member.

query.description: The member email address, internal ID, external ID, or referral code to look up.

timePeriod.description: The duration over which to calculate member statistics.

inputSchema.description: A member identifier and time period for retrieving Referral Rock member statistics.

memberShares.description: The number of times the member shared a link.

referralsCount.description: The number of referrals attributed to the member.

rewardsCount.description: The number of rewards generated by the member.

outputSchema.description: Statistics about a Referral Rock member's activity.

actions.name: list_members
actions.description: List and search members across Referral Rock referral programs.

programId.description: The program ID, name, or title by which to filter members.

query.description: A member email address, internal ID, external ID, or referral code to search for.

showDisabled.description: Whether to return disabled members instead of active members.

dateFrom.description: Return members created on or after this date.

dateTo.description: Return members created on or before this date.

offset.description: The zero-based index at which to start returning records.

count.description: The maximum number of records to return.

inputSchema.description: Filters, sorting, and pagination for listing Referral Rock members.

members.description: The members returned by Referral Rock.

offset.description: The zero-based offset returned by Referral Rock.

total.description: The total number of matching records.

message.description: Additional information returned by Referral Rock.

outputSchema.description: A paginated set of Referral Rock members.

actions.name: list_programs
actions.description: List referral programs in the connected Referral Rock account.

programId.description: The ID of a specific referral program to return.

offset.description: The zero-based index at which to start returning records.

count.description: The maximum number of records to return.

inputSchema.description: Filters and pagination for listing Referral Rock programs.

programs.description: The programs returned by Referral Rock.

offset.description: The zero-based offset returned by Referral Rock.

total.description: The total number of matching records.

message.description: Additional information returned by Referral Rock.

outputSchema.description: A paginated set of Referral Rock programs.

actions.name: list_referrals
actions.description: List and search referrals in the connected Referral Rock account.

programId.description: The program ID, name, or title by which to filter referrals.

query.description: A referral email address, internal ID, external ID, or referral code to search for.

memberId.description: The referring member ID by which to filter referrals.

dateFrom.description: Return referrals created on or after this date.

dateTo.description: Return referrals created on or before this date.

status.description: The referral status by which to filter results.

offset.description: The zero-based index at which to start returning records.

count.description: The maximum number of records to return.

inputSchema.description: Filters, sorting, and pagination for listing Referral Rock referrals.

referrals.description: The referrals returned by Referral Rock.

offset.description: The zero-based offset returned by Referral Rock.

total.description: The total number of matching records.

message.description: Additional information returned by Referral Rock.

outputSchema.description: A paginated set of Referral Rock referrals.
